question: What set of negating attributes is used to define the supreme reality identified as that one?
premises: That one is identified as the supreme.
It is qualified as partless and eternal.
It is further qualified as free from disease and stainless.
inference: That one is the supreme, partless, eternal, free from disease, and stainless.
uncertainties: The ontological scope of these negations is not expanded here.
plain_english: He is the supreme, partless, eternal, free from disease and stainless.
